note: SH579 — the declared exceptions to 'a red suite is a stop'. A suite that is red either blocks the next commit or has an entry here: dated, time-boxed, and pointing at the open task that removes it. Nothing else. cli/test/red-suites.test.mjs enforces the shape and kills an entry whose task has shipped or whose date has passed, so a forgotten exception goes red instead of quiet. Read docs/agents/build.md before adding one.

exceptions.why: COVERAGE.md names 502 shipped ids fewer than it should, against a recorded floor of 490 — the twelve shipped in one session (SH785 to SH796) and nothing else. It is a documentation mirror in the vigletdocs repository falling behind this one; no assertion about the product went red, and the other twenty-one docs conformance checks passed in the same run, including the vocabulary and stack ones that would notice a real drift. Declared rather than fixed in place because the repair is two commits in two repositories and requires deciding which cluster row each of the twelve belongs to — SH797 is that work, and doing it inside another task's commit is how the last twelve went past. Safe to commit over for exactly as long as it takes to do SH797: the debt is a queue `pnpm test` prints by id on every run, so it cannot grow silently while this entry stands. It goes away in the commit that lowers the recorded count.
